en.title: The Book of De · Chapter Thirty-eight · Heaven's Net
en.原文:
男於敢則殺
男於不敢則栝
□兩者或利或害

天之所亞
孰知亓故

天之道
不單而善朕
不言而善應
不召而自來
彈而善謀

天罔𮵚𮵚
疏而不失
en.字龕:
### 罔 *wǎng* ／ 网 — the net

**字 Graph** ｜ 篆 ![网之篆](/book-assets/hosuke-laozi-en/zhuan/%E7%BD%91.svg)

**文 Gloss** ｜ The silk text writes 罔. The *Shuowen* head-graph is 网: 「庖犧所結繩以漁。從冂，下象網交文。」 — "The cords Fuxi knotted for fishing: from 冂, and below, the picture of a net's crossing threads." It lists 罔, 网 with 亡 added as phonetic, as a variant form; 網, with 糸 "silk thread" added, is the later standard form, and the one Wang Bi writes.

**像 Image** ｜ The first net ever knotted, spread beneath Heaven: an outer frame, crossing cords, open meshes you can see clear through. Heaven's net is not fine — it is certain.

**義 Sense** ｜ As the commentary reads it: 恢恢 (manuscript B writes 𮵚𮵚, read as 恢恢) is Heaven's measure — vast; 疏而不失 is Heaven's faithfulness — wide-meshed, yet nothing lost. The way of Heaven lies not in fineness but in certainty.

en.校記:
Manuscript A (MS A) is badly damaged in this chapter: only 不言而善應, 不召而自來 and 彈而善謀 follow MS A; everything else follows Manuscript B (MS B), and □兩者或利或害 is damaged in both. Graphs are those outside the brackets in the *Changsha Mawangdui Han mu jianbo jicheng* (2014; hereafter *Jicheng*).

- 男於敢則殺: Follows MS B, which writes 男 for 勇 "brave" throughout. MS A opens the chapter with a division dot and reads 勇於敢者□殺, with a 者 after 敢 that is absent from MS B, the Peking University manuscript and the received texts. Its 殺 was a restoration in the 1980 edition; the *Jicheng* reads it directly from a fragment newly joined by Chen Jian, which had been mounted upside down. Wang Bi reads 勇於敢則殺. (*Jicheng* IV, p. 36, n. 179)
- 男於不敢則栝: Follows MS B. MS A reads □於不敢者則栝, likewise with 者. In MS B the right side of 栝 is damaged; the original editors fixed the graph on the ground that 活 is always written with 木 in the silk manuscripts. 栝 is read as 活 "to live"; Wang Bi reads 勇於不敢則活. (*Jicheng* IV, p. 36, n. 179; p. 204, n. 138)
- □兩者或利或害: Damaged in both manuscripts. MS B has lost its first graph. In MS A the whole line is lost: the original editors restored 知此兩者, but since the Peking University manuscript and most received texts lack 知, and for MS B the editors had restored only 此, the *Jicheng* drops 知 and prints 【此】兩者. Wang Bi reads 此兩者，或利或害. (*Jicheng* IV, p. 36, n. 180)
- 天之所亞 / 孰知亓故: Follows MS B; 亞 is read as 惡 "to hate". MS A's 知亓故 was part of the 1980 edition's restoration; the *Jicheng* reads it directly from a newly joined fragment. Wang Bi then adds 是以聖人猶難之 ("hence even the sage finds it hard"), which neither manuscript has. (*Jicheng* IV, p. 36, n. 181)
- 天之道: Follows MS B; MS A's 天之 is also read from the newly joined fragment, and its 道 is lost. (*Jicheng* IV, p. 36, n. 181)
- 不單而善朕: Follows MS B; 單 is read as 戰 "to do battle", and 朕 as 勝 "to win". MS A preserves only 善, a restoration in the 1980 edition, now read directly by the *Jicheng* from the newly joined fragment. Wang Bi reads 不爭而善勝. (*Jicheng* IV, p. 36, n. 182)
- 不言而善應: Follows MS A; both manuscripts agree. For MS A's 應 the *Jicheng* prints a form with 疒 enclosing 應, read as 應.
- 不召而自來: Follows MS A; MS B writes 弗 for 不.
- 彈而善謀: Follows MS A; MS B reads 單而善謀, Wang Bi 繟然而善謀.
- 天罔𮵚𮵚: Follows MS B, which writes 天罔𮵚﹦ with a repetition mark after 𮵚. The 1980 edition and Gao Ming transcribe the graph with 示 beside 圣, the *Jicheng* as 経 with 糸; following the plate, it is given here as 𮵚, read as 恢 "vast". MS A reads 天罔恢□: 天罔恢 was part of the 1980 restoration, and the *Jicheng* reads it directly from a new join of three small fragments; the repetition mark after 恢 is lost. 罔 is read as 網 "net"; Wang Bi reads 天網恢恢. (*Jicheng* IV, p. 36, n. 184)
- 疏而不失: Follows MS B; MS A preserves only 疏而, also on the newly joined fragment. (*Jicheng* IV, p. 36, n. 184)
en.疏:
杳眇曰：勇之於人，用之者殊。勇於敢者，果於有為，強梁犯難，此所以取殺也；勇於不敢者，有勇而自節，審時守分，此所以存活也。老子非不貴勇，乃貴用勇之得其當。所謂「不言而善應」，天不言而四時行，人而不言者，亦可善應天下。用勇之道，亦若是已。

「此兩者或利或害」，同一勇也，因用之殊而利害異焉。非有定法，因時因勢而移，此老子辯證之旨也。

「天之所亞，孰知亓故」，天道之好惡不可以人智測。聖人猶存敬畏，不敢妄度天心，故繼之以天之道四象：不單而善朕，帛書乙本「單」讀為「戰」，「朕」讀為「勝」，天道不待交兵而物自賓服，視王弼本「不爭」，言更質實而義相發明；不言而善應，不待告誡而應答自至；不召而自來，天道感化，無待呼召，物自賓服而至；至若「彈而善謀」（甲本；乙本作「單」），天安然自處而善於圖事，王弼本作「繟然而善謀」，繟訓舒緩，義亦有相通者。

「天罔𮵚𮵚，疏而不失」——乙本「恢」作「𮵚」，从示从圣，今讀為「恢」。甲本作「天罔恢□」，「天罔恢」三字《集成》據新綴殘片釋出，重文號已缺。恢恢者天之量，疏而不失者天之信。恢恢者其量至廣，疏者其隙至大，然善惡之報，如影隨形，終不可以倖免。世人眩於敢之能而昧於不敢之利，不知天之為道，不在於密，而在於必；不以無察而縱，亦不以無形而逃。所謂「夫唯不爭，故無尤」，知此者，可以全生，可以法天矣。帛書王弼之異，要在二端：王弼本多「是以聖人猶難之」一句，見聖人之心常存敬畏；又「不單」與「不爭」、「繟然而」與「彈而」，字有古今之辨，義則相通。兩本相較，帛書文簡義賅，要非後人所能增飾也。
en.疏英:
Yaomiao says: courage, for men, divides by its use. He who is brave in daring is resolute in contrivance, a strong-arm walking into peril — that is what gets him killed. He who is brave in not-daring has courage and reins it in, reading the hour and keeping his lot — that is what keeps him alive. It is not that Laozi holds courage cheap; he holds dear using it aright. As the saying runs, "without speaking, good at answering": heaven does not speak, and the four seasons proceed; a man who does not speak may yet answer all-under-heaven. The way of using courage is the same.

"Of these two, one profits, one harms" — the same courage, profit or harm by how it is used. No fixed rule: it shifts with time and circumstance. This is Laozi's dialectic.

"What Heaven hates — who knows the reason?" Heaven's likings cannot be sounded by human wit. Even the sage keeps his awe and does not presume to guess Heaven's heart. Hence the four images of the Way of Heaven that follow. Without battle, good at winning: silk manuscript B writes 不單而善朕, 單 read as 戰 and 朕 as 勝 — the Way of Heaven joins no battle, and things submit of themselves; set against Wang Bi's 不爭, "not contending," the silk wording is plainer and more concrete, and the senses answer each other. Without speaking, good at answering: no injunction given, and the answer arrives of itself. Unsummoned, it comes of itself: the Way of Heaven transforms by drawing, with no need of calling — things come submitting of themselves. And "unhurried, good at planning" (彈而善謀 in MS A; MS B writes 單): Heaven dwells at ease and plans things well. Wang Bi writes 繟然而善謀 — 繟 is slack and slow — close in sense.

"Heaven's net is vast; its meshes wide, and nothing slips through" (manuscript B writes 天罔𮵚𮵚 — 𮵚, 示 beside 圣, read as 恢; manuscript A reads 天罔恢□, its 天罔恢 recovered by the *Jicheng* from a newly joined fragment, the repetition mark lost): 恢恢 is Heaven's measure — its span is the widest; 疏 is the wideness of its meshes — and yet the requital of good and evil follows like a shadow, and no one walks free by luck. The world is dazzled by what daring can do and blind to what not-daring profits, not knowing that the Way of Heaven lies not in fineness but in certainty: it does not set men free for want of watching, and none escapes for want of form. As the saying runs, "only by not contending is one without fault" — he who knows this can keep his life whole, can pattern on Heaven. The differences between the two texts come to two points: Wang Bi adds the line "hence even the sage treats it as hard," showing the sage's heart keeps its awe always; and 不單 against 不爭, 彈而 against 繟然而 — the graphs differ in age, the senses run together. Set side by side, the silk text is spare of words and whole in meaning — not something later hands could have padded.
en.英譯:
He who is brave in daring gets killed; he who is brave in not-daring stays whole (栝). Of these two, one profits, one harms.

What Heaven hates — who knows the reason?

The Way of Heaven: it strikes not (不單), yet wins well; speaks not, yet answers well; uncalled, comes of itself; at ease (彈 — read here as 繟然), yet plans well.

Heaven's net is vast (𮵚𮵚, read 恢恢); its meshes are wide — and nothing slips through.

校記:
本章甲本殘甚：「不言而善應」「不召而自來」「彈而善謀」三句據甲本，餘皆據乙本，「□兩者或利或害」二本皆殘；字從《集成》（2014）括號外原字。

- 男於敢則殺：據乙本；乙本「勇」皆作「男」，讀為「勇」。甲本章首有分章圓點，作「勇於敢者□殺」，「敢」下有「者」字，乙本、北大本及傳本皆無；「殺」字原釋文作補文，《集成》據陳劍新綴之殘片（原誤裱倒）直接釋出。王弼本作「勇於敢則殺」。（《集成》肆·頁36·注179）
- 男於不敢則栝：據乙本。甲本作「□於不敢者則栝」，亦有「者」字。乙本「栝」字右旁殘，原注以帛書「活」字皆从木旁，據以寫定。「栝」讀為「活」，王弼本作「勇於不敢則活」。（《集成》肆·頁36·注179；頁204·注138）
- □兩者或利或害：二本皆殘。乙本首字殘去；甲本全句殘，原整理者補作「知此兩者」，《集成》以北大本及多數傳本皆無「知」字，乙本原亦只補一「此」，刪「知」而作「【此】兩者」。王弼本作「此兩者，或利或害」。（《集成》肆·頁36·注180）
- 天之所亞　孰知亓故：據乙本；「亞」讀為「惡」。甲本「知亓故」三字原釋文在補文中，《集成》據新綴碎片直接釋出。王弼本此下有「是以聖人猶難之」一句，甲乙皆無。（《集成》肆·頁36·注181）
- 天之道：據乙本；甲本「天之」二字亦據新綴碎片釋出，「道」字殘。（《集成》肆·頁36·注181）
- 不單而善朕：據乙本；「單」讀為「戰」，「朕」讀為「勝」。甲本唯存「善」字，原釋文作補文，《集成》據新綴殘片直接釋出。王弼本作「不爭而善勝」。（《集成》肆·頁36·注182）
- 不言而善應：從甲本，甲乙同。甲本「應」字，《集成》錄作疒中从應之形，讀為「應」。
- 不召而自來：從甲本；乙本「不」作「弗」。
- 彈而善謀：從甲本；乙本作「單而善謀」。王弼本作「繟然而善謀」。
- 天罔𮵚𮵚：據乙本。乙本作「天罔𮵚﹦」，「𮵚」下有重文號；其字1980本、高明皆錄作示旁从圣，《集成》作糸旁之「経」，二錄不同，今從圖版作「𮵚」，讀為「恢」。甲本作「天罔恢□」，「天罔恢」三字原在補文中，《集成》據三小片綴合之新碎片直接釋出，「恢」下重文號已缺失。「罔」讀為「網」，王弼本作「天網恢恢」。（《集成》肆·頁36·注184）
- 疏而不失：據乙本；甲本唯存「疏而」二字，亦出新綴碎片。（《集成》肆·頁36·注184）
